text: A song of ascents. Of David.Had not the Lord been with us,let Israel say, [AA]
Had not the Lord been with us,when people rose against us,
Then they would have swallowed us alive, [AB]for their fury blazed against us.
Then the waters would have engulfed us,the torrent overwhelmed us; [AC]
then seething water would have drowned us.
Blessed is the Lord, who did not leave usto be torn by their teeth.
We escaped with our lives like a birdfrom the fowler's snare;the snare was broken,and we escaped.
t[1]Our help is in the name of the Lord,the maker of heaven and earth. [AD]
